title: ORION Context Item v1
description: One labelled piece of context. Every field except confidence is required: an item that does not say what domain it belongs to cannot be firewalled, and an item that does not say where it came from cannot be believed the right amount. `credentials` is a valid domain in the vocabulary but must never appear on an item -- it exists so the rule can be stated, and the Python reference validator refuses to construct one.

provenance.description: Orthogonal to the plugin's three trust levels, not a replacement. Trust answers whether something may authorize an action; this answers where it came from and how much to believe it.

confidence.description: Defaults to 1.0. An orion_inferred item asserting 1.0 is usually a bug: Orion concluding something is not the user saying it.
